messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Canary cluster eu-west-1 is reporting sustained p99 latency > 1200ms for two minutes. Route: generation-streaming. Auto-alert threshold breached. Paging sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: I'm on it. grabbing dashboards now. any customer reports?

support-lead: Not seeing broad customer tickets yet but one enterprise account reported degraded streaming in EU about 2m ago. CX is triaging.

ml-oncall: Noted. Was there a model or config change rolled to canary in last 30m?

deploy-bot: deploy event: user/redwood/models upgraded to model-v22-quant at 1758009800 -> canary eu-west-1 (10% traffic).

eng-plat: Thanks. Confirming traffic was shifted to v22-quant 10% canary 10:18 UTC.

carla: Quick metrics snapshot: p95 ~ 320ms, p99 ~ 1350ms, error rate steady. Streaming stall counts increased (consumer drop events).

bryan: Is KV cache warmup happening? v22 changed key layout earlier which can increase cold misses.

dinesh: Good call — cache miss rate jumped from 4% -> 42% for canary pods. Also saw increase in GPU kernel fallback to CPU for some attention ops.

ml-oncall: That would explain tail bloat. v22-quant introduced a legacy attention path for long sequences; fallback kicks in when sequence > 1024 due to tokenizer differences.

sre-oncall: Initial mitigation plan: 1) Pause canary traffic shift (stop new sessions to v22), 2) Enable routing fallback to v21 for long sequences, 3) Rollback canary if p99 stays > 1s after 5 min. Executing step 1 now.

eng-plat: pausing canary rollout: `deployctl pause --id user/redwood/models@v22-quant` -> acknowledged. New sessions no longer routed to v22.

inc-bot: Action logged: canary pause by eng-plat at 1758012450.

sre-oncall: Step 2: applying routing rule to send sequences > 1024 to v21 as fallback. Pushing config now.

eng-plat: Pushed rule: `route.match(seq_len>1024)->model:v21` to eu-west-1. Propagating.

carla: After pause + fallback: p99 dropped from 1350ms -> 760ms within 60s. Streaming stalls reduced but still higher than baseline. p95 steady ~ 300ms.

support-lead: Notifying affected customer with a status update. draft: "We're investigating increased streaming latency in EU for short window; mitigation underway; we may rollback the canary. Will update in 15m." Want to send?

sre-oncall: Go ahead. Add note that no data exfiltration and requests still completing (higher latency).

support-lead: Sent.

ml-oncall: Given cache miss and quant fallback, I recommend rollback of v22 from canary and a diagnostics build that includes KV cache keys compatibility + unit test for tokenizer length edge-case.

bryan: Agreed. Also instrumented per-request kernel choice logging to figure why fallback triggered for GPU. Will ship small instrumentation change to canary-only next run.

eng-plat: Rolling back canary v22 -> v21: `deployctl rollback --id user/redwood/models@v22-quant --target v21` starting now. This will drain v22 pods and shift traffic back over 3m.

deploy-bot: rollback started at 1758013600. Canary v22 draining.

carla: Observability: p99 back to ~420ms within 2m of rollback start, streaming stalls nearly normal. tail anomalies persist at low rate.

sre-oncall: Good. Will keep monitoring for 30m then handoff to day SRE. If p99 < 500ms and CV < 10% we'll close page.

support-lead: Customer updated with rollback note and ETA for follow-up postmortem.

ml-oncall: Filing follow-up: root cause likely a tokenizer/quant mismatch edge-case causing longer sequences hitting compat fallback -> kernel CPU path + cache cold misses due to new key format. Remediation: add compat layer, add unit tests, and run canary in a shadow mode before traffic shift.

bryan: I'll create the instrumentation PR and queue a hotfix for key-format compatibility.

inc-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. p99 back under threshold. Page will remain open for 30m monitoring.

sre-oncall: handoff to daytime oncall at 1758016120. Leaving notes: paused rollout, rolled back v22, routing fallback added, KV miss spike was primary correlate, monitoring for regressions.

ml-oncall: tagging postmortem: `incident/1758012345-canary-quant-kv-compat`. Please include customer impact window and timeline.

support-lead: I'll prepare CS summary and coordinate postmortem review with customer success.

carla: Adding a couple graphs to the postmortem: p95/p99 times, KV miss rate, GPU-to-CPU kernel ratio, canary traffic fraction timeline.

sre-oncall: closing live mitigation. If anything flares, re-open. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
